digest.component_or_area: LLM eval fixtures / plan-review container spec
propositions: Twelve cases in plan-review-container.eval.yaml lack a non-empty children list, causing _run_criterion_case to raise ValueError before any model execution
G3-R-uncovered-ac-rebar and G3-FP-covered-by-named-consumer-rebar both raised fixture errors on all epochs and arms, reducing the corpus from 30 to 28 items
Each case's input prose already names its child set; children payloads must be transcribed (not invented) to match the case's existing assertions
plan-review-decomp-shape.eval.yaml documents and implements the correct shape: container criteria run over parent+children decomposition with children as an explicit list
Adding children payloads requires no code changes to eval_solver or provider_parity; eligible_cases picks them up unchanged by design
